attempts.certificate: 1: 在顺序(r,p,q)下，r^p^¬q对应110₂=6；翻转最右变量q后为r^p^q，对应111₂=7。2: ¬r∨¬p∨q为假时(r,p,q)=110₂=6；配对项为¬r∨¬p∨¬q，假值为111₂=7。3: r^¬p^q是索引101₂=5的单个最小项，因此是基本式且仅含奇数索引，类别为CE。4: 按(p,r,s,q)编码，五个最小项索引为2,3,5,C,F，故为PDNF。5: 四变量永真式包含全部16个最小项。6: 全偶式可从8个偶数索引最小项中选取任意非空子集，共2^8−1=255。7: 两项索引为0000₂=0和1001₂=9，构成基本式但既非全偶也非全奇。8: 第4题是PDNF而非PCNF，故输出None。

judges.reason: All eight answers match the stated rules. In particular, the paired terms have indices 6 and 7; item 3 is the odd-index minterm m5; item 4 has exactly the listed minterms 2, 3, 5, C, F in the specified variable order; and the remaining counting and classification results follow from the definitions.
judges.depth_evidence: The most involved item requires translating each four-variable term into its bit assignment, converting those assignments to hexadecimal indices, and recognizing the resulting disjunction as a PDNF. Item 6 additionally counts nonempty subsets of the eight even-index minterms.
judges.explanation_evidence: The certificate checks the term-to-index conversions, the paired false assignment for the disjunctive terms, the parity classifications, the complete tautology PDNF, and the count 2^8−1. Its item 7 check correctly identifies indices 0 and 9 as a basic formula that is neither all-even nor all-odd.
